name: Sister Helena

abilities.name: Punishing Strike
abilities.description: A calculated blow targeting weak points in enemy defenses

abilities.name: Unholy Fervor
abilities.description: Draws on dark power to shrug off attacks that would fell normal warriors

appearance.skin_tone: olive, with ritual tattoos on face
appearance.eyes: green with flecks of unnatural red
appearance.distinctive_features: Heavy black plate armor identical to Brother Marcus, ritual tattoos form geometric patterns on face, moves with practiced military precision

personality.demeanor: Emotionless and mechanical, speaks only when necessary, watches everything with predatory focus
personality.speaking_style: Terse military reports, quotes cult scripture, never uses personal pronouns when referring to herself

beliefs: Personal identity is weakness - the cult is all
Order through strength, strength through service
The old world must burn to create the new
philosophy.approach_to_conflict: Fights with cold, calculated efficiency. Works in perfect coordination with other cultists. Prioritizes protecting the Witch King above all else. Will sacrifice herself without hesitation if ordered. Shows tactical intelligence but never questions strategy. Views enemies as obstacles to be eliminated, not people.

visible: Mace with flanges shaped like claws
Heavy black plate armor with skull motifs
Tower shield emblazoned with unholy symbols
Prayer beads made from finger bones
hidden: Lock of hair from her daughter (all that remains of her old life)

secrets: Was once a city guard captain before the cult corrupted her
Keeps a hidden memento of her daughter, whom she gave to the cult as sacrifice
Sometimes hears her daughter's voice crying in her dreams but forces herself to ignore it
The ritual tattoos on her face track her kills - each geometric pattern represents a life taken
backstory: A former captain of the city watch who was corrupted by cult infiltration. To prove her devotion, she sacrificed her own daughter to the Witch King's rituals. Rose quickly through cult ranks due to her tactical skill and absolute ruthlessness. Now serves as an elite guard, her former identity completely erased by indoctrination and dark magic.
